title: Students and Teacher in 1950s Classroom, 1958 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid shot capturing a 1950s American school classroom in April 1958. Students are seated at wooden desks with papers, while one student stands up in the foreground. A female teacher stands attentively near the window beside a filing cabinet topped with a globe, and a large map of the United States hangs on the wall. The image features classic deckle-edged borders with the original processing stamp 'APR • 58' along the top margin.
